# everpure_azure_volume_groups (Data Source)

Lists the Volume Groups on a Storage Pool.

To look up a single, already-known volume group, use the [`everpure_azure_volume_group` data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/data-sources/volume_group) instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "virtual_machine_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Full ARM ID of an existing virtual machine that can reach the storage pool's subnet."
}

data "everpure_azure_storage_pool" "example" {
  name                = "pool-prod-east"
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

# Lists every volume group on the pool above.
data "everpure_azure_volume_groups" "example" {
  storage_pool_id = data.everpure_azure_storage_pool.example.id
}

# Connects the virtual machine to every volume group on the pool, including ones
# created later: the next apply picks them up.
resource "everpure_azure_virtual_machine_connection" "example" {
  virtual_machine_id = var.virtual_machine_id
  volume_group_ids   = data.everpure_azure_volume_groups.example.volume_groups[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage_pool_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Storage Pool to list volume groups on. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `volume_groups` (Attributes List) The volume groups found, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_groups))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the volume groups.


<a id="nestedatt--volume_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume_groups`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_limit_in_mbps` (Number) Bandwidth limit for the volume group, in megabytes per second (MB/s). Null when unlimited.
- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the volume group.
- `internal_id` (String) Everpure's internal ID of the volume group.
- `iops_limit` (Number) I/O operations per second (IOPS) limit for the volume group. Null when unlimited.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume group.
- `snapshot_protection_policy` (Attributes List) The volume group's snapshot schedule. Null when no schedule is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_groups--snapshot_protection_policy))
- `storage_pool_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Storage Pool this volume group lives on. Same as the data source's own `storage_pool_id`.
- `tags` (Map of String) A mapping of tags assigned to the volume group.

<a id="nestedatt--volume_groups--snapshot_protection_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume_groups.snapshot_protection_policy`

Read-Only:

- `frequency` (String) How often a snapshot is taken, as an ISO 8601 duration using days or smaller units.
- `retention` (String) How long snapshots taken by this schedule are kept, as an ISO 8601 duration using days or smaller units.
